headline: Lusaka–Ndola Dual Carriageway Passes 90 Per Cent Mark, Full Completion Expected Early Next Year
summary: The US$650 million Lusaka–Ndola dual carriageway is more than 90 per cent complete, with full completion expected early next year. The project also includes rehabilitating a 45-km road.
why: Large infrastructure projects like this one shape transport costs and logistics in landlocked Zambia. They are typically funded through public budgets or external financing.
